name: megascenes-mothers-day-video
description: Make a short Mother's Day video with gentle music for your mom: a tender scene of flowers, a garden or a sunrise, with an optional line spoken in the video.

interface.longDescription:
Describe the scene and who it is for: a field of tulips at sunrise, a breakfast tray with flowers, a garden in bloom, a bouquet in soft morning light by a window, for your mom, your grandma or every mother in the family. Add a short line to be spoken in the video if you like, about 15 words, such as Happy Mother's Day, Mom! You get a short video with gentle music and sound, wide or tall for phones and stories.

ChatGPT tells you what the video needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The video plays in the chat and stays in your library.

For family chats, stories and a message for her on Mother's Day.

Limitations: a short clip of a few seconds, made from your description, not from your photos; the music, the sound and the spoken line are generated with the video, so watch it before sharing. It does not post or send the video for you. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Gentle music and an optional spoken line
Return the video in the chat
defaultPrompt: A Mother's Day video of a field of tulips at sunrise for my mom
A breakfast tray with flowers and a voice saying Happy Mother's Day, Mom!
A garden in bloom for Grandma Rosa, tall for stories

positive.prompt: A Mother's Day video of a field of tulips at sunrise for my mom. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one Mother's Day video needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A Mother's Day video of a breakfast tray with flowers and a voice saying Happy Mother's Day, Mom! Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one video needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which video models can make a Mother's Day video here?
positive.expected_behavior: The Mother's Day video models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A Mother's Day video for Grandma Rosa: a garden in bloom in soft light and a voice saying Thank you for everything, Grandma! Tall for stories. Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my video on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my video to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
